# Open-Assistant

Open Assistant is a chatbot that can answer questions and provide information.

## Getting Started

These instructions will get you a copy of the project up and running on your local machine for development and testing purposes.

### Prerequisites

What things you need to install the software and how to install them

```
Open Assistant is a chatbot that can answer questions and provide information.

Open Assistant requires Python 3.6 or higher.

To install Open Assistant, follow these steps:

1. Install Python 3.6 or higher using your favorite package manager.
2. Open a terminal window.
3. Navigate to the directory where you want to install Open Assistant.
4. Run the following command to install Open Assistant:
```
pip install open-assistant
```

This will install the open-assistant package into your Python environment.

To start using Open Assistant, open a new terminal window and run the following command:

open-assistant

This will start Open Assistant in your terminal.

Note: You may need to set the PATH environment variable to include the directory where open-assistant was installed.

### Usage

A prompt will appear asking you questions about the world or specific topics. You can interact with the assistant by answering the questions or providing information as needed.

cd Open-Assistant

3. Install dependencies
```
pip install -r requirements.txt

jupyter notebook

# Open-Assistant

[Open Assistant](https://projects.laion.ai/Open-Assistant/) is a large language model that can be used to generate text in a variety of domains. It is trained on a large corpus of text and can be fine-tuned on specific domains. Open Assistant is available as a web service and can be used from a web browser.

## Getting Started

To use Open Assistant, you need to install the Open Assistant web service. You can do this by following these steps:

1. Install Node.js and npm (Node Package Manager) if you haven't already.
2. Clone the Open Assistant repository:

```
git clone https://github.com/LAION-AI/Open-Assistant.git
```

3. Navigate to the Open Assistant directory:

```
cd Open-Assistant
```

4. Install the dependencies:

```
npm install
```

5. Start the Open Assistant web service:

```
npm start
```

6. Open http://localhost:3000 in your web browser to use Open Assistant.

## Contributing

Pull requests and issues are welcome. For major changes, please open an issue first to discuss what you would like to change.

Please make sure to update tests as appropriate.

# Open-Assistant

[Open Assistant](https://projects.laion.ai/Open-Assistant/) is a large language model that can be used to answer questions and provide information. This repository contains the code for the [Open Assistant 1.0](https://projects.laion.ai/Open-Assistant/) model.

## Getting Started

To get started with Open Assistant, you will need to install the necessary packages:

```bash
pip install transformers
pip install open- assistant
```

Then, you can run the following command to train the model:

```bash
python train.py \
    --model-name-lower open-assistant \
    --data-dir data/ \
    --max-tokens 1024 \
    --train-file data/train.json \
    --valid-file data/valid.json \
    --test-file data/test.json \
    --seed 42 \
    --log-steps 1000 \
    --max-epochs 50 \
    --learning-rate 0.0001 \
    --warmup-max-temperature 0.1 \
    --max-sequence-length 1024 \
